Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE single polished portrait-oriented master illustration of Yuri's original Nery Mizuki mascot. References are the actual character design to match, in particular the big round chibi head (roughly a third of her standing height), short sturdy legs where visible, copper-red wavy hair with layered swept fringe and crown curl, amber eyes, warm round cheeks, cream ribbons at each side (keep the visible knot and tails attached to their original side), oversized dark charcoal-brown zip hoodie, orange pulls and trim, small warm orange M on the sleeve if visible. Match the anime linework and shaded copper palette closely. Clean hand-drawn illustrative detail without gritty textures. Use genuine transparent RGBA background. Single isolated character, clear silhouette, no cast/glow shadow, fog, backdrop, border, lettering, stickers or props. Keep margin around entire framing. Render at largest practical native portrait resolution.
Input images and pose: 1: approved front-view full-body design reference; 2: approved portrait reference for face/hair. Draw neutral front three-quarter full-body standing pose head-to-toe, both rounded shoes fully visible, hands relaxed beside hips, tiny friendly closed smile. Match the reference short charcoal pleated shorts, dark socks and chunky brown/orange lace-up shoes. Avoid long or thin legs.
